newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - August 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - August 18.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on August 18. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Planning Minister Ginandjar Kartasasminta said some of the government's projects would need to be postponed until the economy stabilised again following the decline of rupiah.

Speaker of the House of Representatives (DPR), Wahono, said many people were dissatisfied with the legislature's performance and called on newly elected members to be more open and responsive to the people.
President Suharto has said the slump in the country's currency would be temporary due to the strong fundamentals of the economy.

The ruling Golkar party and the armed forces have reportedly agreed to revive a defunct decree by the country's highest body, the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR), that gives the president a full mandate to take necessary measures in a state of emergency.
